evidence_keywords: Three levels:
Extrapolated asymptote suggests ~2.8% numerical uncertainty on Pd_avg at baseline.
Time-step sensitivity (Baseline mesh):
Residuals: RMS for continuity and momentum below 3e-5
typical 10–15 inner iterations per time step.
mass flow imbalance < 0.2%
Turbulence treatment: unsteady RANS with SST (Menter) + curvature correction;

Leaflet motion not solved; geometry fixed to the observed open pose at peak
Rigid-wall assumption tracks the acrylic test section; not intended for in vivo claims.
Inlet: velocity waveform derived from the bench flow meter
Outlet: time-varying static pressure traced from the distal pressure tap
Viscosity uniform between 3.0–4.0 cP
Effective open area ±5%
ISO 5840-compliant pulse duplicator
22 °C working fluid.

30 cycles per point.
Inlet: velocity waveform derived from the bench flow meter
Outlet: time-varying static pressure traced from the distal pressure tap
Reynolds, Womersley, and orifice area ratios in the model cover the tested ranges

Cycle-mean difference: model lower by 0.9 mmHg.
phase-averaged centerline speed within 6.4% of PIV at peak
matched within 9.1%
